evidence_excerpts: The model of a psychopathological self-schema is depicted in Figure 1 in which habitual negative beliefs about the self (including their personal world and future), become reified through the continuous reinforcement of a feedback loop of affect-biased attention influencing subjective and behavioral symptoms and vice-versa.
text: Biased narrative self-processing can reify dysfunctional self-schemas through affect-biased attention, rumination, and repeated maladaptive interpretation.
